notes_for_editor: The ELO entry gives only a legal location (12S-30E-8) and a bearing from the Black Butte Lookout. No source describes a structure at the ELO point. The story is mostly about the Black Butte Lookout, which is a separate record (us-or-black-butte-malheur-nf, NHLR US 951). Its build date conflicts: Oregon Lookouts gives 1934 and 1936, firelookout.com 1933, and the NHLR 1936. Firelookout.com's 'patrol point 1/2 mile east' may be the ELO point, but nothing confirms it. The ELO record's coordinates (44.5378, -119.1266) are about 1 km from the NHLR point (44.54003, -119.13866), by my calculation. A human should decide whether the ELO record should stay as its own point (kind 'point' if it has no structure) or merge into the Black Butte record. Fact-check 2026-10-21: the ELO page is a four-line record (name, forest, legal location, bearing from the Black Butte Lookout). That is why the story says no source describes a structure at the spot.
